svg.title: How Hive connects your agent and tools
svg.desc: Agents call the hosted Hive endpoint. Hive runs native features, routes shared and provider MCP calls, and queues private jobs for a local helper that initiates outbound HTTPS requests.

g.text: One connection. Three places to work.
Your agent sees one hosted MCP endpoint. Hive routes each call to the right capability.
No inbound port or public tunnel
Tool results pass back through Hive
